name: MIMIC-IT
description: MIMIC-IT is a large-scale multimodal dataset containing 2.8 million instruction-response pairs derived from images and videos, designed to improve vision-language models' perception, reasoning, and planning abilities through in-context instruction tuning. It supports training and evaluation of interactive vision-language models with rich conversational contexts.
reputation: A large-scale multimodal instruction-tuning dataset that has been used in vision-language model research for interactive and instruction-following capabilities.
notes: Dataset created via a scalable automatic annotation pipeline combining human expertise and GPT; released with benchmarks and a trained model.
